subject: POC gate schedule & exec decision cadence for Lumina Health trial
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ng <samantha.ng@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T13:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap — proposed POC gates & owners

Hi Samantha,

Thanks for a productive discovery call earlier. Quick recap and a concrete POC proposal so we can lock timelines: 

1) Objective: Validate Redwood inference runtime (private deployment) against Lumina's clinical-search latency and hallucination thresholds on your anonymized query set.

2) Success criteria (please confirm):
- 95th percentile generation latency < 400ms for 1K token window under a 10QPS sustained load
- Relevance precision >= 82% on the clinical query benchmark you referenced
- No PII leakage incidents in 3 simulated audit runs

3) Proposed cadence & gates:
- Week 1 (May 17–21): onboarding, data access, baseline runs (owner: Lumina eng)
- Week 2 (May 24–28): focused tuning, KV cache config, quantization profile tests (owner: Redwood SE)
- Week 3 (May 31–Jun 4): acceptance runs, QA, and exec readout prep (gate: go/no-go exec review)

4) Decision process: schedule an exec readout the week of May 31. After the readout we'll make a documented go/no-go decision and capture contract next steps (Dedicated capacity proposal or expand hosted).

Action items I took away and owners (please correct):
- Lumina: confirm dataset access point and internal owner for test execution (assigned: Rajiv?)
- Redwood: share detailed POC plan and trial success checklist (attached lumina_poc_plan.xlsx and trial-success-checklist.docx)
- Both: identify exec stakeholders & available windows week of May 31 for a 45-min readout + decision

Notes: I attached a lightweight workbook with the test plan and an editable checklist. If you need any tweaks to the acceptance thresholds above, flag them and we can align before we start.

Next step: confirm Rajiv as the Lumina owner and give us a preferred exec slot (May 31–Jun 2 preferred).

Thanks — looking forward to moving quickly on this.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0147
Redwood Inference

Attachments: lumina_poc_plan.xlsx (workbook), trial-success-checklist.docx (checklist)
From: Samantha Ng <samantha.ng@luminahealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@luminahealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — proposed POC gates & owners

Thanks Jonas — this looks good and mirrors our internal notes. Quick confirmations and one add: 

- Confirmed: Rajiv will own the dataset access and run the baseline tests (I've looped him in).
- Success metric tweak: for relevance precision let’s use a blended metric (precision@5 weighted by clinical-critical labels) — aiming for >= 80% instead of 82%. That gives us a bit more tolerance while still pushing for high quality.
- Security ask: we'll need a completed SOC2 evidence pack and a short note on data handling for our security review. Can Redwood supply the SOC2 evidence snapshot and the expected retention policy for KV cache?

Exec availability: our CPO and Head of Clinical Ops are available on May 31 between 10:00–12:00 PT or Jun 1 after 14:00 PT. Prefer May 31 if it works on your side.

I'll take the owners column and coordinate Rajiv's test schedule.

Cheers,
Samantha Ng
Director, Product — Search & Insights
Lumina Health
Samantha.ng@luminahealth.com

Looping in from GTM management side — thanks for the clear plan. A couple of operational notes to make the exec readout effective: 

1) Readout objective: present quantitative pass/fail on the acceptance checklist + recommended path (Dedicated commit vs extended hosted trial). We should surface cost delta and risk profile.

2) Proposed decision cadence:
- Pre-readout dry run (internal): May 28, 30 min — owners review results and align on narrative (Jonas + Marissa + Rajiv)
- Exec readout + decision: May 31, 45 min (10:30–11:15 PT suggested) — C-suite + Head of Clinical Ops included
- Post-decision follow-up: formal redline and procurement timeline captured within 48 hours if go.

3) Procurement/legal: Samantha — please confirm your procurement contact so we can circulate a draft SOW and our redline guidance PDF (attached: redline_guidance.pdf). If Lumina needs a standard BA or DPA, state that now so legal can prepare.

Jonas — I'll own exec cadence and will lead the dry run. Please circulate a 1-slide TL;DR and the acceptance run artifacts by May 27 COB.
